bio: This bistro is thriving in the casual vibe of the buzzy, alternative Saint Catherine neighbourhood. Selecto never fails to deliver thanks to its knockout set menu. Bistronomic fare that hits the spot every time, with a dash of Mediterranean flair, such as creamy risotto with shrimps or a sun-drenched tartlet of aubergine, coppa and burratina, throbbing in no-frills, down-to-earth flavours....
